g.text: Blunt, factual, calm. Short sentences. Every claim carries a number and a source.
No outrage words ("scam", "fraud", "shocking"). The data does the talking.
We write: "Shell retired 42.3 Mt of credits since 2020. Research covers 23.3 Mt of them. About 5.3 Mt are likely
real. Range: 0.3 to 19.9 Mt. Sources below."
We never write: "Shell's shocking offset scam exposed!"
The method line is stated as fact, not apology: "Estimates from published research (Probst et al. 2024) applied to
registry data. Every number links to its source. Check them."
